Prepare a read-only native derivative comparison at saved GRPO weights.

This does not run GRPO advantages, sampling, training or evaluation. It reuses
the exact input, coefficients and BF16 adjoint from the completed DTPO probes.
manifest.question: On the same factual input and exact saved decoder31 BF16 adjoint, do already-trained stable-control weights have the same large internal propagation as old DTPO weights?
manifest.why_needed: Existing DTPO fixed-input/fixed-seed global VJP grows0.0604→1.1039 at checkpoints5→80. Existing gradient comparisons apply GRPO advantages at DTPO weights; they do not measure propagation at the trained control weights. The saved complete control checkpoint160 survives in an immutable original backup snapshot, so no control training is repeated.
manifest.discriminating_quantity: Two original actor derivative passes at saved control checkpoint160: native target PG and the exact unchanged old decoder31 seed. Compare global parameter VJP, layer adjoints and original B4 Gram to completed DTPO5/40/80 records.
manifest.decision: Use the actual control propagation to decide whether the observed DTPO growth is specific to its learned internal geometry, or whether stable control gradients coexist with similar sensitivity and therefore require stronger attention to the advantage/update projection. No owner or credit change follows from a norm quotient alone.
manifest.counterfactual_scope: A read-only comparison of actual trained states, not a from-scratch randomized causal training experiment. Control160 and DTPO80 have different histories and completed-step counts.

control160_fixed_seed80.scope: Diagnostic VJP with the actual saved checkpoint80 block31-output seed

limits: The saved control160 actor weights are measured on the unchanged15 old matched factual targets plus49 unchanged zero-derivative interface rows. This is not its natural training batch or a GRPO advantage/quality test.
Control160 and DTPO80 have different training histories and step counts. Their contrast is conditional derivative geometry, not a randomized algorithm causal fraction.
Fixed seed is the unchanged stored BF16 decoder31-output tensor, verified by original path/SHA and native applied norm. It is not the control policy gradient or an operator norm.
Natural target PG uses the same old diagnostic coefficients with each actual model log-probabilities. Differences include the output loss direction; they cannot substitute the fixed-seed comparison.
Layer/band gain products and norm-identity residual cosines are dependent finite accounting quantities, not independent causal shares or evidence to change official HF/PEFT/VERL code.
B4 Gram increments use FP32 accumulated-gradient subtraction. Reconstruction residuals remain reported.
These measurements isolate an important internal-sensitivity difference but do not establish which historical update component created it or accept a repair.
